title: Bundle Discount Recapture on Cancelled Kessler Care Retail Plans
content:
# Bundle Discount Recapture

When a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Essentials, Plus or Premium plan is cancelled, a recapture applies if the plan was sold on a Kessler vehicle purchase deal below its retail plan price. The rate depends on how long the plan was in force, counted in whole months from the sale date to the effective date.

| Plan sold on a deal below the retail plan price, in force | Bundle discount recapture rate |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 24 whole months | 1.0 (100 percent) |
| 24 or more, but fewer than 48, whole months | 0.4 (40 percent) |
| 48 or more whole months | No recapture |
| Not sold below the retail plan price on a deal (for example, bought on its own) | No recapture |

The recapture deducted is that rate times the difference between the retail plan price and the purchase price, rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** A plan with a retail price of 720.00 was sold on a deal for 684.00, a difference of 36.00.
| Whole months in force | Recapture deducted |
|---|---|
| 10 | 36.00 |
| 24 | 14.40 |
| 47 | 14.40 |
| 48 | none |
